name: Foil
description: A hot-foil stamp on paper, raked by the light your cursor carries

notes: WebGL2 for gl_VertexID; there is no WebGL1 fallback and none is planned
Pointer-driven, never pointer-dependent. With no cursor the light orbits on its own, so it works on touch and under reduced motion
Five evaluations of the height field per pixel: one for the mask, four for the gradient
No render targets, no textures, no allocations per frame

paper.description: The paper the stamp is pressed into. Match it to your page background or the panel reads as a pasted-in rectangle.

foilLow.description: The foil where the light does not reach. Metal takes almost all its colour from the highlight, so this wants to be genuinely dark.

foilHigh.description: The foil at the highlight. Copper by default; a pale grey here gives silver, a yellow gives gold.

spokes.description: Points on the rosette. Above about 24 the petals are narrower than the relief and it turns into a disc.

scale.description: Size of the stamp relative to the shorter side of the element.

relief.description: Depth of the brushed relief. At zero the foil is a flat shape that changes brightness, which reads as plastic rather than metal.

sharpness.description: How tight the highlight is. High is a mirror finish, low is a brushed one.

iridescence.description: Spectral shift at grazing angles. Past about 0.6 it stops being a foil and becomes a hologram.

lightHeight.description: How far above the surface the cursor's light sits. Low is a hard raking light that sweeps a narrow band; high floods the whole stamp at once.

grain.description: Paper tooth. Static by design. Animated grain flickers, and a flicker this fine is what WCAG 2.3.1 exists to prevent.

period.description: Seconds for one orbit of the idle light, which is the motion used when no pointer is present. Exactly periodic, so the loop has no seam.

reducedMotionTime.description: The single frame shown when the user prefers reduced motion. Pick a light angle where the relief is legible.

instruction: move the cursor. it carries the light
